description:
Power outages explained by someone who's spent years on the other side of the breaker.

Why your neighbor gets power back first. What size generator you actually need. Which viral "free energy" hacks are nonsense. On this channel, electrical grid operations are explained in plain English, so you can keep your family safe, warm and powered when the grid goes down.

New videos every Thursday and Sunday.

Narration uses an AI voice. Research, scripts and technical review are done by a human with real grid experience.

⚠️ Educational content only. Always hire a licensed electrician for any electrical installation.
